Classes & Exams

English 1st Paper is arranged lesson-wise using the Udvash regular-class syllabus. English 2nd and Bangla 2nd include syllabus topics. Bangla 1st Paper is arranged into গদ্য, কবিতা and সহপাঠ. Class completion and exam completion are two independent checkboxes for each class.
